question: Where can I get the locations of electrical substations in Spain (transmission and distribution), with voltage level and operator?

answer.summary: CNMC consolidates official transmission and distribution substation points in public ArcGIS services, with voltage in kV and operator code/name. The October 2026 layers contain 937 transmission rows (787 substation keys) and 6,182 demand / 6,227 generation distribution rows from 59 / 61 operators. These are access-capacity busbars above 1 kV, with separate layers that can be queried without registration. Coverage of every distribution substation is unverified, some distribution coordinates are wrong, and planned assets are not separately flagged.
main_caveats: Counts are busbar records, not installations. Deduplicate within each operator using SUBESTACION and retain all voltage levels; shared sites can have more than one operator.
The regulatory scope is substation busbars above 1 kV. The distributor register includes operators exempt because they have no such substations; its company count is not a missing-substation count.
The reporting schema admits existing and planned substations. The public layers have no explicit commissioning/status flag, so they do not establish an operational-only inventory.
The tested distribution geometry contains misplaced points: 2 i-DE demand rows outside Spain and 65 generation rows far from their declared Catalan provinces. Details are in source 1.
Generation and demand differ in coverage; use both. CNMC points do not supply enclosure polygons, and no reuse licence was stated in the checked layer metadata.
answer.confidence_reason: The national API and its fields are directly verified. Coverage outside access-capacity reporting, some coordinate errors, and several fallback leads remain unresolved at the page limit.

steps: The count and two-row URLs above are the exact requests tested. The CNMC sector page links both apps; their public ArcGIS item data reveal the web maps and service URLs.

The layer limit is 2,000 records. Pagination was tested with where=1=1, outFields=*, returnGeometry=true, outSR=4326, orderByFields=OBJECTID, resultOffset=0/2000/4000/6000, resultRecordCount=2000 and f=json. Stop when exceededTransferLimit is false.
Demand distribution, generation distribution and demand transmission were fully retrieved only for validation. The card does not deliver a derived inventory.

For a substation table, preserve network type and GESTOR_RED, group the busbar rows by the manager-supplied SUBESTACION, and collect NIVEL_TENSION values. Generation/demand are overlapping snapshots, not additive installation lists.

Validate geometry against declared territory before using coordinates; retain the source coordinates and flags rather than silently changing CRS. Query the Capacidad_Periodo table to read the snapshot month.
reading_traps: Counts tested: demand distribution 6,182 rows / 2,834 keys / 59 operators; generation distribution 6,227 / 2,872 / 61; demand transmission 937 / 787 / 1. The distribution union has 2,881 manager/substation keys and 5,253 distinct manager/substation/voltage combinations. None of these is a count of distinct physical enclosures.

All 6,182 demand-distribution, 6,227 generation-distribution and 937 demand-transmission rows had geometry and nonempty GESTOR_RED, DESCRIPCION, SUBESTACION, NIVEL_TENSION, PROVINCIA and MUNICIPIO. This does not establish national completeness.

Two demand-distribution R1-001 rows for STR PRADO POZUELO, Madrid, are at longitude 33.874235142605116, latitude -3.039686540410521, outside Spain. They represent one manager/substation key. No generation-distribution or demand-transmission row failed the broad Spain envelope [-19,5] longitude / [27,44.5] latitude.

A deliberately broad Catalonia envelope [-0.5,3.5] longitude / [40.3,43] latitude found 65 misplaced generation-distribution rows: 64 from R1-018 ESTABANELL Y PAHISA and one from R1-014. Demand has the same R1-014 SE PLA ESTANY/Girona anomaly at (-3.178117483418323,42.04444260075014). These checks detect large errors, not every boundary error.
Example generation R1-018 E.R. BIGUES declares Barcelona / Bigues i Riells del Fai but returns (-3.7800306370555883,41.66665809482425). No correction is assumed.

The generation app configuration contains an obsolete Generacion_en_Distribucion layer 0 URL returning JSON error 400 Invalid URL. The current public web-map item uses layer 4; HTTP 200 alone does not mean a valid API result.

The reporting regulation distinguishes existing and planned identifiers, but the exposed SUBESTACION values are names/codes without a separate status field. Capacity occupied or admitted is not an operating-status flag.
Maps may visually filter zero-capacity nodes. The tested where=1=1 requests retain zero-capacity rows.

problems: The generation app retains a stale layer 0 reference; use the current web-map layer 4.
No explicit open reuse licence or geometry accuracy statement found in the checked layer metadata and CNMC sector page.

steps: The exact Python batch above was executed; its e-distribución and UFD GETs both returned HTTP 200. The same batch also retested REE (200) and the CNIG catalog (closed connection). Parse the two distribution CSVs as UTF-8-sig, delimiter semicolon, preserving header order.

The first line is the header; subsequent records contain decimal commas. Select operator, substation identifier, name, numeric kV and X/Y; preserve all voltage rows before grouping by operator/substation.

ETRS89 UTM in the national format uses zone 30 on the peninsula, zone 28 in Canarias and zone 31 in Baleares. The tested first rows converted with EPSG:25830 to (-2.598941179120505,36.813530694530705) for AGUADULC and (-8.397867212153258,43.34300015340447) for EIRIS.
The operator census resolves additional R1 codes; no untested URL pattern is a guarantee that another operator publishes a working file.
reading_traps: e-distribución repeats Provincia and Municipio headers: first numeric codes and later names. A dictionary parser may silently overwrite the first pair.
UFD coordinates and several capacity headers carry [1], [2], etc.; do not require an exact header match to e-distribución.
Each substation repeats at several voltages. Row counts 1,853 and 676 are not substation counts.
The standard specifies zone 30 for the entire peninsula, including Barcelona and Galicia; do not choose UTM zone from the geographic province automatically.
The first card overstated an unavailable i-DE site and a need for REE download impersonation; this session opened i-DE with the web tool and fetched REE CSV with the default client.

regulator.name: Comisión Nacional de los Mercados y la Competencia (CNMC)

operators.note: Red Eléctrica is the sole transmission-system operator; distribution has many registered network managers. MITECO publishes their register. The current test found 325 distinct R1 codes by regex, not a count of substation-owning operators.

publication_obligation.norm: Circular 1/2021 art.12; Circular 1/2024 art.16; Resolution 30 April 2025; Circular informativa 6/2025
publication_obligation.what_must_be_published: Network managers publish georeferenced substation busbars above 1 kV with voltage and access capacity; distribution CSV/XLSX columns include operator code. Circular 6/2025 requires systematic reporting to CNMC and explicitly permits detailed republication of annex II/III capacity data.
publication_obligation.frequency: Monthly; distribution files and reports are due within the first five days of the following month.

consolidated_republication.note: An independent sector check found the consolidated CNMC source before the first card was read. It is a national access-capacity dataset, not a complete register of every electrical asset.

checked_pages.saw: The sector page explicitly says CNMC compiles operator submissions and publishes monthly maps, linking separate demand and generation ArcGIS apps.
Article 7.2 permits publication at annex II/III detail; annexes include coordinates, substation, voltage and operator.
Explains distribution operators and links the official distributor census.

national_registry.note: CNMC provides a single national consolidated publication through demand/generation apps, each with transmission/distribution services. This is a qualified yes for a national dataset, not proof of an exhaustive cadastral-style asset register.

checked_pages.saw: National monthly consolidated maps from managers' submissions.
National distributor census, not a substation inventory.
Transmission capacity downloads; the tested CSV lacks coordinates, while CNMC now publishes points for the same 937-row scope.

recipe: The tested manual example reads sections a (petitioner), b (facility and requested authorization), c (site/parcel/coordinates), and d (voltage/equipment) of BOE-B-2025-24110. Record each fact with the document date and URL.

For an unresolved named facility, the same official search can locate its own notice; extract only fields actually printed there and retain the authorization stage. The Altiplano example demonstrates extraction, not a method to infer unlisted substations.

Coordinates in this example are explicitly the substation centre in ETRS89 UTM zone 30. The commas in 522,269 / 4,156,847 are thousands separators in this document, whereas commas in operator CSVs are decimals.

A petitioner/promoter is not automatically the current operator. Where the document gives only a petitioner, retain that label and leave the current operator unresolved. The opened example cannot prove an exhaustive national completion.
if_unstructured.location_method: Use coordinates or cadastral references explicitly printed in the relevant official document. The tested Altiplano notice supplies centre coordinates and their CRS; no geocoded municipal centroid or inferred site position is used.

where_published.name: Boletín Oficial del Estado: electricity authorizations and public notices
where_published.what: Individual official authorization/public-information documents can supply missing location, promoter and voltage fields. They are not an exhaustive current asset register.
where_published.how_to_search_inside: The national BOE search page separates legislation, other provisions and announcements. Full-text terms such as subestación, the facility name, kV and the operator identify individual notices; a notice can describe a proposed asset rather than a commissioned one.

example_document.what_it_gives: Opened and manually extracted sections a–d: petitioner E-Distribución Redes Digitales, S.L.U.; Nueva Subestación Altiplano; Baza (Granada); 400/132 kV, 315 MVA; ETRS89 UTM zone 30 centre X=522269, Y=4156847; parcel reference 18024A00500131. This is an application/public-information notice, not proof of operation.

open_questions: The CNMC public geometry has clear region/coordinate contradictions (R1-001, R1-018 and R1-014). The intended locations and the publication correction schedule require authoritative clarification; no silent coordinate repair is justified.

The exposed CNMC services do not state whether every obligated operator has submitted usable data. An authoritative completeness statement and the intended reuse licence were not located in the checked sector page and layer metadata.
